items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: I mean it goes from Bruce Springsteen to Elvis Costello and I think these people are frauds.

ctx.x: And so I just quote Ray. Because it is. It’s literally just talkin’. So that has been very detrimental. I think people, there are so many anti-Christs that I have, you know, of singers that I don’t think belong in front of a microphone that are very popular now. They have, they sound like frogs croaking a song out and they have no pitch and I mean it goes from Bruce Springsteen to Elvis Costello and I think these people are frauds. Just utter total frauds.
Do you think the American Idol syndrome and stuff plays into that?
